dct_creator_sm: City of Milwaukee Department of Neighborhood Services
dct_description_sm: This tabular dataset contains 1,669 City of Milwaukee properties recorded as vacant in the Department of Neighborhood Services Accela system as of September 18, 2026. Fields include the date opened, full address, land-use code, parcel number, improvement value, aldermanic district, ZIP code, census tract, and neighborhood. PARCELNBR can be used as a tax-key join to the City of Milwaukee Parcel Polygons and Master Property File datasets. The source portal states that data are extracted daily and that newly recorded vacancies may take up to 72 hours to appear.
Original source: City of Milwaukee Open Data Portal.
